entries.text: Welcome to MiniBlog, a simple platform to read and publish blog posts.
Let us create a new account by clicking Sign up.
We pick a username.
We add an email address.
And we choose a secure password.
Now we sign up. The app logs us in automatically.
To demo the login screen, let us first log out of the new account.
Now we click Login to sign back into the same account.
We enter the email we just signed up with.
And the same password.
We hit Log in, and we are right back into our account.
We click New Post to start writing.
We give the post a clear title.
And we write a short message for our readers.
We hit Publish, and the post is live right away.
Here is the published post with the title, the author and the full content.
Going back to the homepage, the new post sits at the top.
Anyone can click a post to read the full version.
Because we wrote this post, we can also delete it.
And just like that, the post is gone from the list.
